create_BaseDataset: create a BaseDataset instance to load and preprocess multimodal data for the MoFo framework
build_train_val_test_split: build train, val, or test partitions from dataset info using configurable train and val ratios
preload_dataset_with_audio_and_text: preload the full dataset into memory including audio, text annotations, and body features
get_chunk_data_by_sequence: get a chunk of data for a specific subject and sequence with optional start frame offset
retrieve_item_by_index: retrieve a single data item by global index with optional multiperson data loading support
